novel_features.name: Dated inventory with overnight dates
novel_features.description: See service-day dates and inventory uncertainty explicitly.
novel_features.rationale: Combines public service attributes with safe availability classification.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Prevent timetable and midnight date mistakes.

novel_features.name: Stop-pair party fare evidence

novel_features.rationale: Replay source fare table for actual route-local stop IDs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Avoid treating the headline from-fare as the party total.

narrative.headline: Read-only bus routes, dated inventory and source-grounded fares.
narrative.value_prop: Discover directional timetables, then check dated services and exact boarding-pair fares. Overnight dates and unknown capacity remain explicit.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public searches need no login. Each command creates a temporary memory-only session; no cookies or credentials are stored.
narrative.when_to_use: Use for Japan Bus Online route discovery, dated service comparison, boarding-stop selection and read-only fare or baggage planning.
anti_triggers: Bookings, payments, cancellations or account history
Guaranteed seat adjacency or group discounts
